checkedAlternates.risk: Pomelo and Grapefruit look similar in size and flavor.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Pomelo is one of the three ancestral pure citrus species (group-2), whereas Grapefruit is a hybrid of pomelo and sweet orange (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Lemons are often assumed to be a primary citrus species.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Genomic studies show lemons are hybrids of citron and bitter orange (group-3), not a pure ancestral species (group-2).
